summary: Runtime parchment map kit: paper + ink layer + icon atlas composed in DialogBox_Map
author: pm
body:
The user wants the Map item's parchment built at runtime in the client from a kit, in their words: "add the building objects to this at the same relative scale and overwrite this. Then build a kit that can be constructed via runtime in the game".

Icon sheet, done 2026-11-24 (measured):
- `working/sprite_work/map_icons.png` now holds the user's sword and blue/red portals on top, and below them nine buildings from Helbreath-SDL `working/objects`. The buildings share one scale (0.1835) with their bottoms aligned.
- An atlas of frame rects is at `working/sprite_work/map_icons.json`. The user's original sheet is backed up at `.claude/scratch/pm/mapkit/map_icons.before.png`.
- Each building was identified by the door teleport it stands over:

| building | SDL id | door |
|---|---|---|
| city hall | 1025 | cityhall |
| cathedral | 1028 | cath |
| command hall | 1014 | cmdhall |
| guild hall | 1026 | gldhall |
| wizard tower | 1023 | wzdtwr |
| shop | 1021 | gshop |
| warehouse | 1022 | wrhus |
| blacksmith | 1030 | bsmith |
| barrack | 1027 | arebrk/elvbrk |

Icons still missing from the user's sheet: an exit arrow (46 exits on the maps) and a dungeon-entrance marker (43).

The kit:
- the high-quality paper;
- a per-map ink layer made by `tools/parchment_map`;
- per-map icon placements (`--icons-json`);
- the icon atlas.

The client composes these in `DialogBox_Map` instead of reading `interface/newmaps.pak`.

**Done when:** using the Map shows the runtime-composed parchment, with icons and the player marker; Windows and Linux builds pass; reviewed; checked in game.

Source: user request 2026-11-24.

**Verified, 2026-11-24:** Windows and Linux client builds passed. A read-only review passed after two fixes: the map name is checked, and the no-map message now shows. In game on `default`, the Map item opened the kit parchment with icons and the player marker. The minimap steps between its two tiers and clamps at mid. Committed as babe5aa.
